title.zh: HuggingFace / OpenEnv · 鹈鹕 SVG 评分对照
title.en: HuggingFace / OpenEnv · Pelican SVG scoring reference

description.zh: 同一份上游实验：数据由 HuggingFace 发布，评分来自 OpenEnv 环境。7 个模型标签、139 条主任务记录；30 条题面覆盖样本单列。
description.en: One upstream experiment: data published on HuggingFace, scored by the OpenEnv environment. Seven model labels and 139 main-task rows; 30 prompt-coverage samples are separate.

title.zh: Pelican Benchmark · 动态 HTML 评测跑道

description.zh: pelicanbenchmark.com 评测站公开的动态 HTML track。收录 29 个模型独立代码生成的自包含 HTML 动画原件与运行预览。
description.en: The animated HTML track from pelicanbenchmark.com. Features 29 standalone code-generated HTML animations and runtime previews across models.

title.zh: Tihu · 鹈鹕 SVG 专项评测

description.zh: 同一提示词下的型号与档位样本集中展示，保留 SVG 原件、出处与历史编号。上游 AI 参考分单列，不计入常规馆藏。
description.en: Source model/effort samples with their original SVGs, provenance and former archive numbers. Upstream AI scores remain separate from the main collection.
